scripts.fix-iconv: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['node_modules/iconv-lite/package.json','node_modules/body-parser/node_modules/iconv-lite/package.json']) { if (fs.existsSync(p)) { const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')); delete pkg.browser; fs.writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)); } }"
scripts.build: npm run fix-iconv && prisma generate && wrangler types && tsc --noEmit
